what: The self-audit of cert-machine, Phase 1 — the inventory: per register row and per record, what exists before anything is measured (the re-derive command, the standard-library verifier, the second implementation, the rerun kit's measured seconds, the per-row timing field, and whether the row is mutable under the pre-registration's class table or why not). Every field derived from the register, the kit, the kit's run record and the records; the class table is the pre-registration's. Written by tools/run-selfaudit-inventory.js.
name: selfaudit

refusals.scope: the configuration as published, in exact arithmetic

the fits are to a commercial hindcast nobody outside can re-run; against the nearest cells of the public one they are 19 OFF THE MAXIMUM, 1 OUTSIDE ITS SUPPORT — the distance between two records, not an error

the expressions are not published: the paper says all six discoveries "are detailed in Appendix A", which details three (A.1–A.3), none of these; agreement with a reference to 20 digits would not decide equality in any case

mutation.classes: an aggregate of six audit lanes with no single object to mutate
